blocks.text: A Dental CPA Can Explain the Advantages of Structuring a Practice as a Partnership

One way to improve your odds of building a successful dental practice is to form a partnership. This might be with one or more other dentist-owners, or it might be with a person or entity that wants to contribute financially to the practice in order to share in the profits. While sharing the risk and the rewards of a dental practice can help protect you as an individual, it is vital to set up the partnership formally, in writing, with the help of a dental CPA.

A dental CPA from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help make sure that no important details are overlooked when the partnership agreement is drawn up. The details of this form of business [tax structure](http://reliancecpa.com/dental-optimal-tax-structure) can include:

items.text: The date the partnership becomes effective
Signatures of all partners and interested parties
The term (length) of the partnership, if any
Distribution of profits among partners and the practice
